newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - PLDT a buy - BPI Securities.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PLDT a buy - BPI Securities.

text.p: Manila brokerage BPI Securities Corp recommended a buy on Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co saying the shift from a flat rate scheme to a metering system next year will mean a more efficient telephone company.
"The implementation of the local metering system will declog PLDT's network allowing for more subscribers to use the network, less busy signals and clearer lines," BPI said in research paper.
At present, PLDT residential customers pay a flat monthly fee of 300 pesos regardless of the length of calls.

PLDT and all the other telephone firms are planning to seek approval from the National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) to impose a metering scheme. The scheme will charge customers depending on the length and distance of calls made.
With the metering scheme, BPI said more local carriers will seek interconnection with PLDT which would mean more earnings from access charges that the dominant carrier will impose.
The scheme will also pave the way for PLDT to stop cross subsidy of domestic calls by international calls.
